Free Boat Rides + Fleet Week Waterfront Fun at India Basin Park (SF)

Saturday, October 10, 2026 - 11:00 am to 3:00 pm | Cost: FREE
India Basin Waterfront Park | 900 Innes Ave, San Francisco, CA 94124

Event Details

Celebrate Fleet Week at the park with a FREE concert, boat rides, games, military challenges, kids’ swag, community resources, and more!

Join us for Fleet Week Family Day at India Basin Waterfront Park and celebrate Fleet Week on the water! Bring out the whole family out for a free afternoon filled with live music, outdoor games, military challenges, free boat rides, kids’ giveaways, community resources, and more. Enjoy a special performance by the U.S Air Force Band of the Golden West Brass while connecting with neighbors and community partners. This family-friendly event is free and open to the community, so come ready for a fun day on the waterfront!

Disclaimer: Please double check event information with the event organizer as events can be canceled, details can change after they are added to our calendar, and errors do occur.
